_note: GOLD RULES - the ONE machine-readable control site for every AntCV generation (owner 2026-07-13). Narrative + enforcement map: docs/qa/GOLD_STANDARD_LOCKER.md. Consumers: pwa/antcv-bullet-targets.js (prompt block on every generation/Fit-it/Enhance call), scripts/job-tracker/{quality_pass,density_fit,measure_density,gen-runner}.py (persist + sweep enforcement). Served at antcv.pages.dev/gold-rules.json so workers can fetch it (proxy prompt-augment wiring = open follow-up). Change values HERE; code reads them.

results.rule: a Results line needs a QUANTIFIED OUTCOME OR SCOPE (change metric, or number+object of an action verb like '100 users across 150 machines'); digits that only DESCRIBE the role context (team size, site counts, years) do not qualify
results.descriptors_are_bullets: team sizes, site names, headcounts and years are role bullets, never Results

compressions: Languages, food culture and board games shared with friends
Languages, food culture and board games
Technology, society and systems thinking books and essays

identity.cv_banner: specialization triad; Application line only when the stored subtitle is empty (CLs keep it)

accessibility.note: every text ink luminance-checked against its fill, ON TOP of any sampled company brand; adjust the ink, never skip the check

brand.note: brand palettes apply only to apps marked to that brand (per-app styleConfig); unmarked apps render the neutral package palette

prompt_block: - Every Results line states a CHANGE metric (a percentage, multiplier, from->to, time/volume/money delta) with its mechanism. A team size or site description is a bullet, never a Result.
- Core-competency tables: at most 2 rows, the highest-impact ones; every cell a complete clause, one line where possible.
- Table first-column labels stay SHORT (about 28 chars max): a label that wraps to three lines or one-word rows in its cell is invalid; compress the label instead.
- Every bullet and sentence ends COMPLETE with terminal punctuation - never a dangling connector or preposition ("...traceable from"), never a cut enumeration ("...optics, electronics, mechanical.").
- Name partner/client companies only when the job description itself signals them; otherwise describe the relationship ("an ODM partner").
- Certificates carry no years; order them by relevance to this job.
- Interests and sidebar one-liners stay compact (drop filler words); keep personality lines intact but never pad them.

page_budgets._note: per writing style; mirrors antcv-style-page-budget.js STYLE_PAGE_BUDGET (engine reads remain there until wired)

tables.narrow_cell_cascade: a table cell rendering 3+ lines, or 2+ lines averaging ~1 word per line, is INVALID (owner 2026-07-13, Tech Mahindra focus-area cell) - hard-compress the label first; widening tableRatio is the second lever if the other column tolerates it

roles._note: ROLE CONTROL (owner 2026-07-13 'make sure your work fits in the golden gating matrix role control ... I want also danish spanish and chinese canon'). Identity: the stable canonical role id is the LANGUAGE-AGNOSTIC identity (SAME-ID 1.51.353, BASE-ID + GEN-ID 1.51.358) - a suffixed backfill twin (<id>-2) or a gen schema id (r1..) at the same company/tenure is the SAME position; exactly ONE role per canonical id survives dedupe, canonical id wins (the Results pins key on it). Titles: per-language RENDERINGS of that identity come from canon_titles below - deterministic, so LLM title drift can never fork a position across languages. Enforced by antcv-sections-normalize-415.js roleCanonTitles (runs after dedupe on en/da/es/zh ribbons; he/am/ar keep the translate output); mirror-drift gated by pwa/test/unit/gold-role-canon.test.mjs. A merged title with MORE '&'-segments than the canon (deliberate merge-or-split structure) is never overwritten.
